newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares busy, Union Bank leads.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares busy, Union Bank leads.

text.p: Shares on Estonia's stock exchange picked up activity on Tuesday, with third-largest bank Union Bank featuring as the busiest stock, dealers said.
Business in official list shares was 12.9 million kroons and the Tallinn stock exchange index rose 0.23 percent to 109.40.
Union Bank saw volume of 4.1 million kroons and closed higher at 22 kroons versus 21.80 kroons. Dealers said the big volume was due mainly to bloc trades.
Forekspank was active again as it traded three million kroons of shares and closed lower at 75.25 kroons versus 75.50 kroons.
Savings Bank traded 1.4 million kroons of shares and rose slightly to 50.25 kroons.
Dealers said the shares from its latest stock issue, which hit the market today, had little impact on its stock price.

The over-the-counter free market turned over a healthy 7.4 million kroons and the Norma plastics maker was the most active on trade of 2.6 million kroons and it ended higher at 28.60 kroons versus 27.90 kroons.
